list.title: Your listings
list.description: Buyers and lead matching use your live listings. Every new version is checked, and often reviewed, before it goes live.
list.emptyDesc: Describe what you sell in a few lines and AI will draft it for you. Without a published listing you cannot be matched to buyers.

new.title: New listing
new.descAi: Tell us what you sell. AI will draft it and you check it before it goes live.

exportPage.title: Export listings
exportPage.description: Download your catalogue as Excel or CSV, optionally with photos.

importPage.title: Import listings
importPage.description: Add or update many products at once from an Excel or CSV file, or a ZIP that also holds your product photos.

edit.title: Edit listing
edit.description: Edits are saved to your working copy. Buyers see a new version only after you submit it and it is approved.

editor.rejectedTitle: We could not accept this version
editor.approvedBody: Your version passed the checks and is being published. Buyers will find it within a minute or so.
editor.rejectedDefault: It appears to break the marketplace policy.
editor.rejectedBody: {note} You can edit it and submit again, or contact us to appeal.
editor.submittedBody: Our team is checking it against the marketplace policy. It goes live automatically once approved. Anything already live stays unchanged meanwhile.
editor.aiDraftNote: AI draft, check before submitting. Fix anything that is wrong: price, minimum order and specs matter most to buyers.
editor.saved: Saved to your working copy. Buyers see nothing new until you submit it for review.
editor.title: Title
editor.priceHint: Per unit. Leave blank to show 'Ask for price'.
editor.hsnHint: 4, 6 or 8 digits. It helps match your listing to your GST.
editor.imageLinksHint: One https:// link per line, up to 5. Photo upload is coming soon; for now paste links to photos you already host.
editor.rejectedFallback: This listing was rejected by the policy check.
editor.footnote: Every version, including AI drafts, is checked against our prohibited-category policy and is reviewed before it goes live.
editor.tiersHint: Offer a lower price per unit for bigger orders. The first tier starts at or above your minimum order; quantities go up and prices never go up.
editor.certificationsHint: Comma separated, for example ISO 9001, BIS

versions.changeNoteHint: Shown to our reviewers and in your history.
versions.changeNotePlaceholder: e.g. Updated price and added 3-ply option
versions.publishAtHint: Leave empty to go live as soon as it is approved.
versions.waiting: Your latest version is already waiting. Edit and save the listing to submit a newer one.
versions.noChanges: No changes since the live version.
versions.title: Versions and publishing
versions.intro: Buyers only ever see the live version. Saving edits changes your working copy; submit it for review to publish it.
versions.noVersions: No versions yet. Submit your first one above.
versions.previewNote: Preview links open the buyer page with a "not live" banner and expire after an hour; reload this page for a fresh link.

actions.draftMin: Write at least a sentence about what you sell.
actions.titleMin: Give the listing a short title.
actions.descMin: Describe the product in a sentence or two.
actions.moqMin: Minimum order must be at least 1.
actions.imageLink: Use full links starting with https://
actions.prohibited: This category is not allowed on the marketplace. See the prohibited-category policy.
actions.priceUnitNeeded: Choose the unit this price is for.
actions.moqUnitNeeded: Choose the unit for the minimum order.
actions.badDate: Pick a valid date and time.
actions.approvedScheduled: Version {version} approved. It goes live at the scheduled time.
actions.approvedLive: Version {version} approved. It goes live within a minute.
actions.submitted: Version {version} submitted. Our team will review it; your live listing stays unchanged meanwhile.
actions.offline: Listing taken offline. Buyers no longer see it.
actions.tierInvalid: Price tier {n}: enter a whole quantity and a price.
actions.tradeNumber: Enter whole numbers only for lead time, capacity and sample price.

aiDraft.label: Describe what you sell, like you would tell a buyer on WhatsApp
aiDraft.hint: What is it, size or grade, minimum order, price, and where it ships from. Hindi, Hinglish or English all work.
aiDraft.tapExample: Tap an example to start from it
aiDraft.footnote: AI writes a draft only. You review and edit everything before it goes live. Photos: you can paste image links in the next step; direct photo upload is coming.

upload.network: Network problem. Please check your connection and try again.
upload.failed: We could not draft your listing. Please try again.

photo.typeError: Use JPEG, PNG or WebP photos.
photo.maxError: You can add up to {max} photos.
photo.title: Create from photos
photo.intro: Take or choose 1 to 4 photos of one product. AI drafts the listing; you check it, and staff approve the photos before buyers see them.
photo.hintLabel: Anything AI cannot see in the photo? (optional)
photo.hintHint: Price, minimum order, size, material. Hindi, Hinglish or English.

voice.tooLong: That recording is too long. Keep it under 5 minutes.
voice.empty: Nothing was recorded. Please try again.
voice.stopped: Recording stopped unexpectedly. Please try again.
voice.notAudio: Choose an audio file (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg or webm).
voice.fileLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
voice.micBlocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone in your browser settings, or upload a voice note instead.
voice.micNotFound: No microphone was found on this device. You can upload a voice note instead.
voice.micBusy: The microphone is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
voice.micFail: We could not start recording. You can upload a voice note instead.
voice.title: Describe by voice
voice.intro: Say what you sell, the size or grade, minimum order and price, in Hindi, Hinglish or English. About 30 seconds is plenty. The recording is deleted after it is transcribed unless you allowed voice retention in Settings.
voice.unsupported: Recording is not available in this browser. Upload a voice note instead (for example one recorded on your phone).
voice.longNote: Longer notes take more time to transcribe. Stop whenever you have said the key details.
voice.transcribing: Listening to your note and drafting…

export.title: Download your listings
export.intro: You get every listing that is not archived: the same columns as the import template, so you can edit the file and import it again with "update by SKU". Listings without a SKU get one assigned (like L-3F9A1C2B) so they can be updated later. Files are kept for 7 days.
export.includePhotosNote: (downloads a ZIP with products file and an images/ folder; rejected photos are left out).

import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 200 MB. Split it into parts.
import.step1Body: The templates come with dropdowns, hints and three example rows (marked EXAMPLE, skipped on import). The starter kit is a ZIP with the Excel and CSV templates, an example photo and a README, ready to add your own photos to.
import.upsertNote: (matched by SKU). Empty cells on an existing product are left unchanged.
import.createOnlyNote: Rows whose SKU already exists are reported as errors.
import.submitAfter: Submit each product for review after importing.
import.submitAfterNote: Otherwise products stay as drafts you submit later. Nothing goes live without the usual checks and, where needed, staff review.
import.drag: Drag a .xlsx, .csv or .zip file here, or
import.limits: Up to 5,000 products. ZIP: up to 200 MB with an images/ folder next to products.xlsx or products.csv.
import.validating: We are checking every row. Large files take a minute. You can leave this page and come back.
import.noProblems: No problems found. Nothing has been imported yet; confirm below.
import.draftsOnly: Imports only change your drafts. Photos from a ZIP go through the same staff approval as photos you add one by one, so they show on your live listings only after they are approved.
import.importN: Import {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}
import.runningLeave: . You can leave this page; the import continues.
import.cancelledNote: Cancelled. Rows already imported stay in your drafts.
import.doneAfterReview: . New photos wait for staff approval; products you submitted follow the normal review.
import.doneAfterDrafts: . New photos wait for staff approval. Submit the products for review when you are ready.
import.problemsTitle: Problems found ({count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}})
import.showingFirst: Showing the first {count}. The error report has every row with its problems, so you can fix and upload just those rows.

images.badType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
images.altChanged: Alt text changed, so this image needs approval again.
images.title: Photos
images.intro: Up to {max} images (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB, at least 200 px). Every photo is checked by our team before buyers can see it.
images.none: No photos yet. Listings without approved photos show a placeholder to buyers.
